notes.title: Construction Simulator 2015 Update (v.1.5)
notes.notes:
Today we are releasing the newest version of Construction Simulator 2015, which will bring you several bug fixes and some smaller features. 

Patch notes: 

Bugfixes

Fixed beacon lights turning on if player enters vehicle
Fixed wrong requirements on multiple missions of DLC "Liebherr LTM 1300 6.2"
Fixed front turn signals of the large mobile crane (LTM 1300)
The large mobile crane (LTM 1300) and the second (green) Semi LowLoader are now taken into consideration as prerequisite for the Crawler Crane
Fixed some multiplayer sync issues on the concrete drum component
Fixed missing vehicles in vehicle dealer on Linux


Features

Added content and logic for DLC "Liebherr HTM 1204 ZA"
The concrete crane bucket is now available to all players at the materials trader and can be used on construction sites.
Added message for Windows 10 users with Xbox One Controller for information about alternative branch
Added workaround for steam workshop mods to be added to the game (Windows only, after a restart of the game, subscribe mods should appear in the game)
Added experimental support for Steam Controller (different Action Sets per game state. We will open a thread in the steam forum for this)


Note (XBox One Controller / Windows 10) 
There are issues with the XBox One Controller on Windows 10, which unfortunately can’t be fixed without causing problems on Windows 8 and previous versions. We have uploaded a special version for Windows 10  for players experiencing these control issues. (The version is identical otherwise)

To download this version:

Right-Click Construction Simulator in your Steam Library -> Properties -> Betas -> Select “windows10”

After a short update, the version should be adjusted. (May requires a steam restart to trigger the download)


Important Note: Only players with the same version see each other in multiplayer. So make sure you are up to date.

notes.title: Construction Simulator 2015 Update (v.1.4)
notes.notes:
Dear community,

we are happy to present you the latest and so far most extensive update for Construction Simulator 2015 today. Next to the new virtual vehicle hall as well as the long awaited advanced support for modding vehicles in multiplayer games the update also includes language support for Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese as well as a bunch of additional game improvements. Here is a detailed overview:

Patch notes: 

Bugfixes

Fixed internal crash when exiting the game with (e.g. Alt+F4 on Windows)
Improved communication with Steam to determine if the game is running
Fixed missing text in Large Excavator tutorial
Crawler crane assembly is aborted if the vehicle is sold
Sold vehicles get properly unregistered from locations
Improved Mod-Vehicle import (e.g. if Shaders are missing)
Target indicator implemented for Mod-Vehicles (e.g. Hook-Component) 
Preview pictures for Mod-Vehicles implemented
Outriggers of the small trailer have a larger threshold for their retracted state
Improved automatic steering of the Semi LowLoader and the Heavy-duty Trailer to reduce the amount of time it takes for those trailers to re-align themselves
Fixed incorrect hydraulics behaviour on excavator shovels
[MP] Fixed multiplayer synchronization of Mod-Vehicles (e.g. "Mammoet" Trucks)
[MP] Fixed drag of cargo objects already connected to a hook for joining players
[MP] Improved initial positioning of cargo objects for joining players
[MP] Improved ramp collider behaviour of the Lowboy Trailer for Clients, making it easier to drive vehicles on it
Fixed an issue which prevented the update of a player’s active mods after unsubscribing a mod and restarting the game
Fixed an issue which would show mission indicators for cargo objects too early in a mission


Features

Steam API Update
Language added: Turkish
Language added: Brazilian Portuguese
Mouse cursor gets hidden on inactivity
Mod-Vehicles are tagged in the motorpool menu
Launch option "-console" activates an ingame error log (Ctrl + ,) which should help with mod debugging
Rotating lights stay activated when exiting a vehicle and have to disabled manually
If a contract requires the construction site of the hospital, players get an additional prompt to confirm/decline the removal of the hospital.
Launch option "-resetSpecialMission" allows players to reset and replay previously finished contracts (e.g. the early stadion missions). This option requires the ID for each mission (e.g. "-resetSpecialMission=m3050_stadium_001"). Applicable missions are:

g0000_homebaseCity_001
g0000_industrial_001
g0000_vehicleTrader_001
g2020_hotel_001
g2030_developmentArea_001
g2030_hollywoodHills_001
g2030_hollywoodHills_002
g3050_industrial_002
m2030_School_001
m2030_School_003
m2030_specialPool_001
m3050_specialPool_002
m3050_stadium_001
m3050_stadium_002
m3050_stadium_003
m4040_School_002

Added the option to re-import Mods in order to simplify testing. Requires the launch option "-modDebug"

Mod-Vehicles can be re-imported by clicking their (new) mod-indicator in the motorpool menu. The vehicle needs to be inactive.
All Mod-Missions can be re-imported with the Refresh button in the architect missions menu. Currently active missions aren’t updated before their next start.

"Vehicle Hall" added (Motorpool menu)

Vehicles can be stored, allowing players to have a larger amount of vehicles in their possession
Running expenses for stored vehicles are halved
Automatically unlocked with the acquisition of the larger company grounds
Max amount of active vehicles: 30 (6, before acquiring the larger company grounds)

When creating an multiplayer game, players can enter a short description of their game, which will be visible to other players in the game’s lobby before joining
The following settings of a multiplayer game can be changed retrospectively:

Password
Max Players
Game Description
Min. Player Level



Mod Editors 
We also updated the mod editors for missions and vehicles. You can find them in the corresponding discussions in steam.

Note (XBox One Controller / Windows 10) 
There are issues with the XBox One Controller on Windows 10, which unfortunately can’t be fixed without causing problems on Windows 8 and previous versions. We have uploaded a special version for Windows 10  for players experiencing these control issues. (The version is identical otherwise)

To download this version:

Right-Click Construction Simulator in your Steam Library -> Properties -> Betas -> Select "windows10"

After a short update, the version should be adjusted. (May requires a steam restart to trigger the download)


Important Note: Only players with the same version see each other in multiplayer. So make sure you are up to date.

notes.title: Community Update June 2016
notes.notes:
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/261587814208156947/A25DE4D0B964B527E58876F57E83094F8C28B616/

Dear Community,

today we would like to share more details of the current status of Construction Simulator 2015. At the end of June we will release a new patch which will include the virtual vehicle hall. With this new feature you will be able to have more machinery of the same type and mod vehicles in your vehicle park than ever before.

Aside from that we will introduce Turkish and Brazilian Portuguese languages into the game.

Next to this the update will include several fixes and an increased performance due to various enhancements as well as new features for single- and multiplayer mode requested by you as well as the support of mods in multiplayer mode. A complete changelog will follow with the release of the update itself. So stay tuned!

Beyond that we are currently working on three new DLC-packages which will be released in 2016. The sixth DLC will include the following:

6th DLC: MAN® TGX D38
In this DLC package we will introduce extended heavy cargo which will need to be transported by you. This package will also contain additions to the vehicle park with the very powerful MAN® TGX D38 Truck and the new LIEBHERR® LTM 1300 6.2 mobile crane. You can test your skills in multiple brand new “heavy” and challenging missions.

In 2016 we will be shipping two more DLC-packages, including the LIEBHERR® A 918 mobile excavator, which we revealed recently. More detailed information will follow in time.

We hope that you will like the short glimpse on what comes next for Construction Simulator 2015. We would like to use the opportunity and say a huge THANK YOU to all of you. Without your support and continuous constructive feedback the very positive journey of Construction Simulator 2015 wouldn’t be possible.

Your weltenbauer. Team

notes.title: Note: Upcoming Update & DLCs
notes.notes:
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/275092284508462650/072A5BDC16D429DB908B0DB569FE583FC4E94719/

Dear community,

2016 is a busy year for us. We have already achieved great steps, but there is still much to do. According to plan we will provide Construction Simulator 2015 with new, high quality content and also present you one or two surprises till the end of this year.

The first of these steps will be the upcoming update for Construction Simulator 2015 which is already under construction. In addition to various game improvements and bug fixes, this update will also bring a virtual vehicle depot into the game. The depot can be used to store currently unneeded vehicles. This way all problems connected to the limited number of parking lots at your homebase should belong to the past. With the update players will be able to hold multiple vehicles of the same type, which is great for multiplayer sessions, and also have additional mod vehicles in the fleet without having to sell vehicles when space is running low. We opted for this solution, because it is reasonable and can find its way into the game without any problems.

In addition to the update there are currently three DLC packs planned for Construction Simulator 2015. With these expansion packs we will not only bring new missions but also a number of new originally licensed MAN® and LIEBHERR® vehicles and construction equipment into the game. All of those DLC contents will of course be 100% multiplayer compatible and also fully functional in single player mode. Among other things the new DLC packs will contain the long-awaited A918 wheeled excavator of our partner LIEBHERR® as well as a four-axle MAN® TGX D38 truck. More detailed information will follow in time - so stay tuned!

Parallel to the development of the update and the next DLCs for Construction Simulator 2015, we are already working on a new project for smartphones and tablets, which we will reveal soon. At this point once again a big thank you for your years of loyalty and support. We are already looking forward to 2016 and for sure will continue on this crazy year together with you!

Your weltenbauer. team

Today we're releasing version 1.06 of Construction Simulator 2015 with some major improvements.

Patch notes:

Bugfixes
Fixed some problems with support legs and ramps of vehicles and trailers
Improved synchronization of cargo objects in multiplayer
Concrete mixing tower (gravel pit) should now work reliable

“Player joined” message should now be localised properly

Fixed digging terrain initialisation taking to long in sand box

Fixed turning signals in multiplayer

Multiplayer lobby refresh optimized
Fixed missing lights on some vehicles
Improved digging with small excavator
Fixed skidmarks/terrain marks of some vehicles
Fixed some audio issues

Mod missions are now always visible (but locked if requirements are not met)
Fill amount of bulk-transport vehicles (e.g. Halfpipe Truck) is now displayed in m³
Improved accessibility of one site in village
Added warning when trying to drive but ramps are still lowered
Improved vegetation on road to gravel pit
Added new vehicle type to NPC cars
Lowboy trailer now is officially able to transport cargo (area extended to include to upper part aswell)

Reset controls with button now returns to default key assignment properly

Multiplayer
Improved stability if more than one client joins a game at the same time

Fixed vehicle stabilizer synchronisiation

Added info messages to clients on disconnect of master/when game was closed
